xna-type.name: SharedGraphicsDeviceManager
xna-type.summary: Handles the configuration and management of a shared graphics device.
xna-type.syntax: public class SharedGraphicsDeviceManager : IGraphicsDeviceService, IDisposable, Object

property.name: GraphicsDevice
property.summary: Gets the GraphicsDevice associated with the SharedGraphicsDeviceManager.

property.name: GraphicsProfile
property.summary: Gets the GraphicsProfile associated with the SharedGraphicsDeviceManager.

property.name: MultiSampleCount
property.summary: Gets or sets the number of per-pixel samples.

property.name: PreferredBackBufferFormat
property.summary: Gets or sets the format of the back buffer.

property.name: PreferredBackBufferHeight
property.summary: Gets or sets the preferred back-buffer height.
property.remarks: If you request a back-buffer resolution that is not supported by the output device, the XNA Framework automatically selects the highest resolution supported by the output device. For example, if a graphics back buffer with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 (1080p or 1080i) is created and displayed on a device with 480i resolution, the back buffer is resized automatically to 480i.

property.name: PreferredBackBufferWidth
property.summary: Gets or sets the preferred back-buffer width.
property.remarks: If you request a back-buffer resolution that is not supported by the output device, the XNA Framework automatically selects the highest resolution supported by the output device. For example, if a graphics back buffer with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 (1080p or 1080i) is created and displayed on a device with 480i resolution, the back buffer automatically is resized to 480i.

property.name: PreferredDepthStencilFormat
property.summary: Gets or sets the format of the depth stencil.

property.name: PresentationInterval
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum rate at which the swap chain's back buffers can be presented to the front buffer.

property.name: RenderTargetUsage
property.summary: Gets or sets render target usage flags.

property.name: SynchronizeWithVerticalRetrace
property.summary: Gets or sets a value that indicates whether to sync to the vertical trace (vsync) when presenting the back buffer.

method.name: ApplyChanges
method.summary: Applies any changes to device-related properties, changing the graphics device as necessary.

overload.summary: Applies any changes to device-related properties, changing the graphics device as necessary.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Releases the unmanaged resources used by the SharedGraphicsDeviceManager and optionally releases the managed resources.

overload.summary: Releases the unmanaged resources used by the SharedGraphicsDeviceManager and optionally releases the managed resources.

parameters.parameter: true to release both automatic and manual resources; false to release only manual resources.

event.name: DeviceCreated
event.summary: Raised when a new graphics device is created.

event.name: DeviceDisposing
event.summary: Raised when the GraphicsDevice is being disposed.

event.name: DeviceReset
event.summary: Raised when the GraphicsDevice is reset.

event.name: DeviceResetting
event.summary: Raised when the GraphicsDevice is about to be reset.

event.name: Disposed
event.summary: Raised when the SharedGraphicsDeviceManager is disposed.
